nodes.name: GET /api/automation/run/{run_id}
nodes.notes: Phase 18G: migrated from /api/admin/automation/{run_id} (admin session auth) to /api/automation/run/{run_id} (x-automation-secret + AUTOMATION_ENABLED kill-switch). The new route returns the same {run, editorialItem, recentEvents} shape as the admin route.

nodes.name: POST /api/automation/ai-assist
nodes.notes: Server-side AI assist call. Returns a draft title + body. Persists a content_hash server-side; we still pass the body downstream as the operator-resumable payload.

nodes.name: POST /api/automation/fact-check
nodes.notes: If the provider is not configured, the server returns provider_status='not_configured' and the editorial item is held at fact_check_state='pending_manual'. n8n MUST NOT auto-pass on timeout.

nodes.name: Promote FF90-02 output
nodes.notes: Phase 18G: terminal promote. Re-emits canonical envelope to MASTER.
